summary: The install prompt in iOS mode, showing add to home screen instructions inside a reserved stage box.
use: Prompting Safari on iPhone users, who have no native install event, to install the app to their home screen.
spec: Wrapped in `<div class="stage">` with `min-height: calc(var(--ca-space-8) * 3)` so the page does not shift when it appears
No handlers or state in the demo, the prompt renders only after mounting in the browser
